subject: FactoryObject method
notes: kb/Work PB1506, LANDED (wave 59). Rule: 'When invoked on an instance object, the FactoryObject method determines the class of the object and returns a reference to the factory object associated with that class.' (cite.py --check 16.2.2.2 -> OK §16.2.2.2 1)). The runtime BASE.FACTORYOBJECT() returns __FactoryOfClass, which every emitted BASE-derived class overrides with its own factory singleton, so the most-derived override is the runtime class's factory. pb1548_standard_class_base: an object of D held in an A-typed reference answers D's factory (line 3 'D-FACTORY'), SELF "FactoryObject" in an inherited method likewise (line 7), and through a reference described BASE into a universal item (line 8). Not FINAL (§16.2 declares no FINAL), so a subclass may OVERRIDE it and redefining it without OVERRIDE is §11.7.3 SR4a's COBOL0837 (StandardClassBaseTests). retired-witness: conformance-test:StandardClassBaseTests.FactoryObject_Override_AndUniversalNew_IntoAConformingTypedReceiver (train 1055 cluster C (kb/Work PB2463) renamed it FactoryObject_Override_AndUniversalNew_CreatesTheFactorysClass: a universal New into a typed receiver of the subclass no longer matches BASE's New (section 9.3.6 rule 6), so the test now receives into a universal reference and still witnesses the FactoryObject override)
